name: EPIC 247300559
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 19.7 solar radii and 1.54 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 247300559 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 19.712794 (16th-84th percentiles 18.340666-21.153099), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,966 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.54 solar masses and 19.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,518 K at its surface.
